name: Potentially Suspicious Cabinet File Expansion
description: Detects the expansion or decompression of cabinet files from potentially suspicious or uncommon locations, e.g. seen in Iranian MeteorExpress related attacks
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\expand.exe AND process.command_line:(*\-F\:* OR *\/F\:* OR *–F\:* OR *—F\:* OR *―F\:*)) AND ((process.command_line:(*\:\\Perflogs\\* OR *\:\\ProgramData* OR *\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\Admin$\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\C$\\* OR *\\Temporary\ Internet*)) OR ((process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Favorites\\*) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Favourites\\*) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Contacts\\*))) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Dell\\UpdateService\\ServiceShell.exe AND process.command_line:*C\:\\ProgramData\\Dell\\UpdateService\\Temp\\*))
